seoTitle: How to Activate Your TurboTax Online Product
metaDescription: Activate TurboTax Online with the 16-character code from your retailer receipt or Intuit account: where to enter it, the one-code-per-account rule, and how to fix a product mismatch.
intro:
TurboTax Online is browser-based, so there is nothing to install. There is still an activation step, though, if you paid for the product up front. Intuit issues a 16-character activation code for retail purchases and for Do It Yourself products bought directly from Intuit, and that code has to be entered against your Intuit Account before the paid product unlocks.

This guide covers where to find the code, the sign-in screens you pass through (as they appear in the recording), and the one rule that causes most activation errors: each Intuit Account can only take one TurboTax Online code per tax year. If you chose Start for free on the homepage and plan to pay when you file, you have no code to enter and can skip straight to signing in.
prerequisites: Your 16-character activation code: on the receipt or confirmation email for a retail purchase, or under Products & billing in your Intuit Account if you bought directly from Intuit
Access to the email address and phone number on your Intuit Account, for the verification code

tables.note: Code locations and the activation path are from Intuit's TurboTax support articles, checked September 2026.

steps.heading: Sign in with the right Intuit Account
steps.body:
Go to TurboTax.com/activate and choose I have an account or Create an account. The recording signs in from the TurboTax homepage instead, where Sign up and Sign in sit at the top right and a Let's get you in to TurboTax panel appears on the right with your last-used email filled in. Either route ends at the same Intuit sign-in.

The account matters more than the route. TurboTax shares one Intuit Account with QuickBooks, Credit Karma and Mailchimp, so if you have used any of them, sign in with that account. A second, accidental account is the usual reason a paid product seems to have vanished.

image.caption: The TurboTax homepage with Sign up and Sign in at the top right and the Intuit sign-in panel pre-filled with a saved email.

steps.heading: Create an account only if you've never had one
steps.body:
New users land on a Let's get you in screen asking for an email address and a phone number, with a Create an Intuit Account button. Intuit uses the phone to send a verification code by text or call, and the screen notes that standard call or SMS rates may apply.

If you already have an account, don't fill this in. Use the Sign In link under the button.

image.caption: The Create an Intuit Account screen, asking for an email and phone number, with a Sign In link underneath for existing users.

steps.heading: Pick the saved account, or switch to another
steps.body: On a browser you've used before, Intuit shows the account it remembers along with when and where it was last accessed. Click it to continue. If it's the wrong one, the Other actions section offers Use a different account and Remove a user ID. Enter the one-time code Intuit sends to finish signing in.

image.caption: The account picker showing a previously used Intuit Account, with Use a different account and Remove a user ID below.

steps.heading: Enter the activation code
steps.body:
After sign-in you reach a screen titled Welcome to TurboTax--let's get started. Type your 16-character code into the field under 2. Activate your purchase and select Continue. Then select Finish activation, and Start my taxes to open your return.

If you bought from Intuit directly, you can start from your Intuit Account instead. Open Products & billing, copy the license number, and select Activate online, which takes you to TurboTax.com/activate.

steps.heading: Check the product matches what you paid for
steps.body: Once inside your return, confirm the product tier shown is the one you bought. To move to a cheaper product, open Switch Products in the left menu and select Downgrade. Clear & Start Over (under Tax Tools > Tools, or from Switch Products) also changes product, but it erases everything you've entered, and it's only available if you haven't paid, deducted the fee from your refund, or registered the product.

troubleshooting.problem: TurboTax shows an error when you enter your activation code
troubleshooting.cause: Intuit allows one TurboTax Online code per Intuit Account per tax year. If a code was already activated on this account, a second one is rejected.
troubleshooting.fix: Check whether this account already has an activated product for the year. If the new code was meant for someone else's return, activate it under that person's own Intuit Account.

troubleshooting.problem: You bought directly from Intuit and can't find a code anywhere
troubleshooting.cause: Direct purchases don't come with a code on a receipt. Intuit keeps it in your account.
troubleshooting.fix: Sign in to your Intuit Account, open Products & billing, and copy the license number shown there.

troubleshooting.cause: Intuit blocks it once you've paid, chosen to deduct the TurboTax fee from your refund, or registered the product.
troubleshooting.fix: Use Switch Products > Downgrade if you only need a different tier, or edit the return manually.

faq.question: Do I need an activation code for TurboTax Online?
faq.answer: Only if you paid up front. Retail purchases and Do It Yourself products bought directly from Intuit come with a 16-character code. If you started for free and pay when you file, there's no code.

faq.question: Where do I enter the code?
faq.answer: At TurboTax.com/activate. After you sign in, enter it under 2. Activate your purchase on the Welcome to TurboTax screen, then select Continue and Finish activation.

faq.question: Can I use two TurboTax Online codes on one account?
faq.answer: No. Intuit allows one TurboTax Online code per Intuit Account per tax year, and a second code triggers an error.

faq.question: Can I use TurboTax Online on more than one device?
faq.answer: Yes. The return is stored with your Intuit Account, so signing in from another browser opens it where you left off.

faq.question: Why does Intuit keep sending me a verification code?
faq.answer: It's a security check sent to the phone on your account. Ticking Remember me on the sign-in panel of a private device cuts down how often you see it.
